frozen_before: every textspot training run and every score of any arm (baseline or candidate) on the textspot development or test frames

reading.how: every detection's box (frame pixels, as the arm returns it) is cut from the frame, turned to grey ((77 R + 150 G + 29 B) >> 8) and read by the C runtime in W8I with greedy CTC decoding, with VOCR_INVERT when the box's dark flag (vocr_line_dark on the frame) is 1; a vertical box is turned 90 degrees anticlockwise first (vocr_column_rotate) and read by VOCR5-V

grad.what: vocr_find_lines(frame, VOCR_LINES_GRAD): the whole frame as one region

grad_refine.what: grad, then vocr_lines_refine with VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT on the frame

grad_refine_gate.what: grad_refine behind #101's gate in boxes mode on the frame (k 4, t -8): no box when the gate says no text

s8c24_textdet.what: #97's detector through its own finder (synth/textdet_twin.find_lines, vocr_textdet_find) on the frame: horizontal and vertical lines, at most 16

s8c24_textdet_refine.what: s8c24_textdet with its horizontal lines through VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT on the frame (#97's det+refine)

s8c24_spot.what: #97's s8_c24 blob through the textspot decode at full resolution (pack(blob, half_above 0, conf_min 1)): the #97 detector run full-frame

columns.what: #103's column finder (vocr_find_columns, VOCR_COLUMNS_VALLEYS) on the frame: vertical boxes only

grad_refine_columns.what: grad_refine's boxes plus every column of `columns` of which less than half the area lies inside one grad_refine box

baselines.blocks: every baseline's boxes go through textspot_twin.group_and_order (blocks, order, pick) too

dev.role: the only data the selection reads
dev.sources: the local copies of their VNDB screenshots (realdata and devnative shots), deduplicated by VNDB screenshot id and sha256; content flags sexual < 0.3 and violence < 0.5 when known
dev.order: a frame's rank is sha256('textspot-dev:' + shot id), a VN's sha256('textspot-dev-vn:' + vn)

composition.vita: native 960x544 PS Vita screenshots, up to 5 per VN by rank
composition.psp: native 480x272 PSP screenshots, up to 2 per VN by rank
composition.adrenaline: for the first 20 PSP VNs by VN rank, the next PSP screenshot by rank not used above, scaled 2x (cv2.resize INTER_LINEAR) to 960x544
composition.pc: for the first 40 VNs with PC (hires) screenshots by VN rank, the first by rank, scaled to fit 960x544 with its aspect (cv2.INTER_AREA), as #97's real canvases
composition.text_free: up to 25 frames with no text at all by eye, drawn by rank from the dev VNs' remaining screenshots where MeikiOCR detects at most one box
composition.dropped: a frame that is not a game screen (box art, photo, a mostly unreadable thumbnail) is dropped by the reviewer and the next by rank is taken

dev.pinned_by: an amendment with the manifest's sha256, before any arm is scored on it

test.role: read once, after the selection is committed
test.frames: every vita-test (74) and psp-test (83) screenshot as a full frame: eval's hand-checked lines are its dialogue (lines tagged name: class name; uncertain lines: ignore) and every other text instance is labelled as the dev set is; plus up to 25 text-free screenshots of the 28 test games outside eval's screenshots; report only: psp-test scaled 2x (Adrenaline)
test.pinned_by: an amendment with the manifest's sha256, before the selection commit
test.rule: no model of this work runs on a test frame before the conductor's single read

sets.protected: the CLANNAD long run (owner-drive-ingest's frozen references): whole frames in, each reference line reads the detections lying mostly inside its GRAD box (at least half of a detection's area in the box it overlaps most), dialogue CER with whole-page intervals; the boxes returned on pages without reference text are counted. Once, after the selection commit, with the test set

labels.instance: one line of horizontal text (characters on one baseline; a gap wider than about 1.5 character widths or a separate UI element starts a new one) or one vertical column
labels.box: the main-text ink box in frame pixels (fill, outline and shadow), refined to ink from an approved proposal; furigana, emphasis dots, page cursors, icons and button glyphs are not part of it

classes.dialogue: story text: ADV and NVL dialogue and narration, monologue, balloon text
classes.name: speaker name plates
classes.ui: menus, buttons, system and HUD labels, dates, chapter titles, save slots, ...
classes.scene: text that is part of the picture: signs, posters, letters, screens, ...

labels.ignore: furigana (an ignore area over the ruby), logos and stylised art text, text under 6 px tall in frame pixels or otherwise unreadable, watermarks and capture overlays, scripts other than Japanese and Latin, rotated or curved text, and any instance whose text two looks could not agree on
labels.text: eval's convention (main text only; full-width ！？～; … for ellipses; eval/metrics.norm), Latin as written
labels.review: proposals: MeikiOCR's detector boxes (with its vertical flag) refined to ink, read by MeikiOCR and PP-OCRv6 small (turned 90 degrees for a vertical box); pass 1 decides each frame's boxes (keep, drop, ignore, split, merge, class, orientation, and missed text as a rough rectangle refined to ink) and every kept box's text from numbered candidates; pass 2, a separate session, rechecks the boxes and reads the text blind (candidates shuffled and unattributed); a disagreement goes to a third look; only text two looks agree on is kept. Reviewer kind 'assistant' (Claude); no Codex, no manga-ocr

metrics.detection: P / R / F1 at IoU >= 0.5 one to one against the references' ink boxes padded by the spotter's pad rule; recall per class; ink tightness (mean IoU, mean ink coverage of matched pairs); detections mostly inside an ignore area left out
metrics.end_to_end: frame units: every reference's Levenshtein errors of its assigned detections' joined readings, plus every character read from a detection assigned to no reference; all text and dialogue (classes dialogue and choice, no junk); CER pooled over frames
metrics.text_free: the share of text-free frames with any box, and boxes per text-free frame (report)
metrics.pick: report only: on frames with dialogue, the picked block's box against the union of the padded dialogue references (IoU >= 0.5), and the CER of the picked block's readings joined in its order against the dialogue references joined top to bottom
metrics.per_platform: report: vita, psp, adrenaline, pc and text-free rows

family_a.what: #97's 34 trained runs (rounds 1 and 3; their final.vtd) through the textspot decode, each as pack(blob, half_above, 1) with half_above 0 and 600; no training

family_b.what: new runs trained for whole frames (train/textspot_train.py); name <scale>_<shape>_seed<n>
family_b.recipe: #97's network, targets (K kernel band, O, A1 / A2) and losses on windows cut from whole frames at the network's input scale (a frame wider than half_above halved by textspot_twin.halve first); 30,000 steps of 16 windows of 256 x 512; AdamW 4e-3, cosine; int8 fake quantisation from step 24,000; half synthetic full frames and half #97's real whole-screenshot canvases per batch; the last step is the run's model; exported by train/textdet_export.py and wrapped by textspot_twin.pack(half_above, conf_min 1). The data pin and the remaining details are fixed by an amendment before the first run
family_b.data: synthetic whole frames (Vita, PSP, Adrenaline 2x, PC at the Vita size, text-free) with exact ink boxes over textgate's clean scene pool; #97's real canvases (realplus, teacher, devnative, owner); excluded: every reserved.json test and dev_sample VN and test session, every eval and eval/linefind screenshot and linefind VN, the owner's CHAOS;CHILD (v14018)

decodes.det+refine: the same, then its horizontal boxes through VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT on the frame

rule.eligible: arena at 960x544 <= 131,072 B (the runtime's exact function; for det+refine the larger of the spotter's and the refinement's); estimated time per 960x544 frame on one A9 core at 333 MHz <= 150 ms (the A9 cycle model's high bound for the shape and scale on the runtime, plus 1.4 ms per horizontal box at the arm's median box count on the dev Vita frames for det+refine); the C runtime gives the twin's boxes on every dev frame
rule.size_order: VTSP blob bytes, then MACs per 960x544 frame, then det before det+refine
rule.qualifies: against every baseline: dev F1 difference with a VN-cluster 95% interval entirely above 0, dev end-to-end CER (all text) difference with an interval entirely below 0, and the dialogue CER difference not resolved above 0
rule.winner: the smallest qualifying candidate W; a larger qualifying candidate replaces W only when its all-text CER minus W's has an interval entirely below 0 (the smallest such, repeated)
rule.no_winner: the verdict is negative; the eligible candidate with the lowest dev all-text CER is the report candidate, read once on the test and protected sets and labelled not promoted

estimates.a9: vita/a9_cycles.py's model on the Vita compiler's code under the plugin qemu-arm, as #97 (eval/textdet_a9.py), on a pinned procedural 960x544 and 480x272 frame; high bound x 1.0007 at 333 MHz, x 333/444 at 444 MHz
estimates.mac_rate: VOCR3-H15's console rate: 1,564,992 MACs per CTC frame at 5.0-5.2 ms at 333 MHz (report)
estimates.label: every console time and memory figure is a host estimate; nothing runs on a console

amendments.before: every family B training run (train/textspot_train.py through eval/reproducibility/textspot-20261019/sweep.sh) and every score of any arm on a textspot frame
what: Synthetic half: data/manifests/textspot_shards_v1.json (pinned below), 80 shards of 1,000 whole frames rendered by synth/textspot_data.py (seed 20261019): vita 27,828, psp 20,063, adrenaline 11,992, pc 8,047 and text-free (src synth:empty) 12,070 frames; 501,887 lines (dialogue 114,822, name 38,831, choice 23,908, ui 297,494, scene 26,832; vertical 35,220) and 25,738 ignore areas, over textgate's clean scene pool cut further (vita 64, psp 985, hires 3,123 scenes of 1,117 VNs: no eval, eval/linefind or CHAOS;CHILD screenshot, no reserved VN). The helper's QA (60+ frames viewed) saw unlabelled scene text the inpainting missed twice; it stays (a small label noise, disclosed).

Real half: #97's real canvases pinned by data/manifests/textdet_shards_v1.json (realplus 40, teacher 10, devnative 1, owner 6 shards; 28,602 whole screenshots at the console's target size, RESERVE_OK against the current reserved.json; #97's synthetic shards are not read), minus what this protocol's exclusions name and #97's did not: every canvas of a screenshot an eval list holds (textspot_shards_v1.json real.measured.skip.eval_screenshot.skip_shots, 77 shots: #103's vertical sets, eval/linefind's candidate lists and psp_pool) and every canvas of the 23 VNs of eval/linefind lists outside #97's four sets (real.measured.skip.linefind_list_vn.skip_vns). The trainer drops them before the pool is built: 337 canvases measured (realplus 22, teacher 143, owner 163, devnative 9; the pin's own count, 332, misses 5 teacher canvases of v15773 that are also devnative shots, a counting key in synth/textspot_real_half.py; the lists are complete). Pool after the cut: synthetic 80,000, realplus 19,683, teacher 5,860, owner 2,658, devnative 64. #97's real canvases make lines under 8 px or over 72 px across ignore areas (its INK_MIN / INK_MAX); they stay so (no loss on them).

Recipe details (train/textspot_train.py, pinned below): windows are drawn one at a time, synthetic with probability 0.5 (#97's draw: 8 of 16 per batch on average), real ones from realplus 0.35, teacher 0.35, owner 0.25, devnative 0.05; a window is 256 x 512 at the network's scale at a uniformly random offset (a canvas that fits is used whole and the layers masked to it, as #97); h2 halves a canvas wider than 600 px with textspot_twin.halve and maps boxes start floor(v / 2), end ceil(v / 2); every line of every class is a positive; a line under 4 px across at the network's scale is an ignore area; #97's round-1 kernel rule (not --strict-kernel), losses, AdamW 4e-3 with 500 warm-up steps and cosine to 1e-4, gradient clip 5, int8 fake quantisation from step 24,000, 30,000 steps; the last step is the run's model; RUN/final.vtsp = textspot_twin.pack(final.vtd, 600 for h2 or 0 for f1, conf_min 1). The 22 runs go through eval/reproducibility/textspot-20261019/sweep.sh (pinned below), at most 5 at once; a crashed run restarts from scratch with the same seed.

The probes (eval/textspot_train_probe_20261019.json: 11 speed probes and 11 300-step smoke runs on #97's shards, 09:3x-09:5xZ, and two 60-step data-path probes on these shards, about 11:30Z, all in scratch directories) are not runs of the sweep; nothing of them is used.

Eligibility inputs: runtime/vocr_textspot.c / .h (the runtime, bit-exact with synth/textspot_twin.py; pinned below) and eval/textspot_a9_20261019.json (its A9 and arena table, pinned below). The rule's arena is vocr_textspot_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544), the bytes for any frame up to 960 x 544 (for h2 the 600-px full-size frame sets it; the 960 x 544 frame's own need is reported); the rule's time is the default call's (dark pass included) A9 model high bound x 1.0007 on a grey 960 x 544 frame at 333 MHz. Every family B shape is eligible by both: 44.8-136.4 ms and at most 80,799 B. RGBA frames and VOCR_TEXTSPOT_NO_DARK are report only (the console's finders read grey rows).

amendments.before: every score of any arm (baseline or candidate) on a textspot development frame
what: The development set is eval/manifests/textspot-dev.jsonl (pinned below): 188 frames of 81 dev_sample VNs (vita 39 of 10 VNs, psp 64 of 32, adrenaline 20, pc 40, text-free 25 of 19 VNs; 88 capture sessions, none a test session), 885 labelled instances (ui 519, dialogue 249, name 96, choice 15, scene 6; 41 vertical) with 6,770 characters after eval/metrics.norm (dialogue 3,851, choice 136: the dialogue measure's 3,987), and 196 ignore areas (unreadable 44, small 38, logo 35, watermark 29, undecided 24, rotated 23, furigana 3). Reviewed as the protocol says (two looks per box and text, a third on disagreement; pass 2 approved 96.7% of pass 1's boxes and agreed on 97.7% of its texts); the helper's spot check of 20 frames and the conductor's of 2 (one Vita, one PC frame) found no error. Built by eval/textspot_sets.py (pinned below); the PSP frames' 2x Adrenaline copies and the PC frames' fit to 960 x 544 are its scale_frame steps.

The harness is eval/textspot.py (arms, reading, scoring, the frozen baseline, select) and eval/textspot_protected.py (the single protected read), pinned below; eval/textspot_metrics.py and the twins stay as frozen at ceff220. The frozen baseline (every baseline arm on the development frames, read with VOCR5-N and VOCR5-V for the rule and VOCR5-S and VOCR5-L as report) is committed before any candidate is scored on a development frame.
